decided: At apply, orbit refused to render an archived change's brief, and any program brief containing it, naming the record, when that change's archive record did not state its sync in the field orbit reads today.
alternatives: treat a record that says nothing either way as one whose sync ran
show such a change as archived without an archive record
why: A brief says only what the archive recorded and never infers a sync, and a brief is shown whole or not at all. The records this refused were taken to state neither outcome; the system review showed that two of them do state their sync, in an older shape, and the system walk replaced the refusal by reading those shapes.
detail: src/core/program-brief.ts readArchive as applied: an archive-<TS>.json whose sync_specs was not an object with a boolean ran failed the brief. Four of this repo's 66 records were refused: 2026-07-17-d2-architect (specs_synced: true), 2026-07-21-d3-orientation (sync.synced: true), and 2026-06-11-relocate-modified-upstream-workflows and 2026-07-06-c1-engine-gates (sync_specs listing capabilities, no ran). Superseded by the system walk's decision B (D-br-8).
